tooltip.elementalcrystals.inert: An inert crystal. Right-click to awaken it.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.fire.passive: Immune to fire and lava damage.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.fire.primary: Ignite Burst - engulfs nearby enemies in flame and empowers your strength. (20s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.fire.secondary: Flame Dash - dash forward leaving a burning trail. (12s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.frost.passive: Immune to freezing; chills nearby enemies.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.frost.primary: Freeze Burst - roots and damages nearby enemies. (30s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.frost.secondar: Ice Wall - grants a defensive Resistance shield. (18s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.frost.tradeoff: Permanently slowed while the crystal is active.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.lightning.pass: Immune to lightning strikes; may chain a shock when struck.
tooltip.elementalcrystals.lightning.prim: Storm Dash - dash forward and shock enemies on landing. (15s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.lightning.seco: Static Pulse - knockback nova that shocks nearby enemies. (10s cooldown)
tooltip.elementalcrystals.lightning.trad: Storm Dash costs hunger and deals self-damage on use.
message.elementalcrystals.awakened: Your crystal awakens with the power of %s!
message.elementalcrystals.on_cooldown: The crystal is still recharging (%s s left).
